learner_operation: Apply explicitly specified elementary row operations to an ordinary 3-by-3 coefficient matrix and select the resulting matrix. Read indexed row roles, carry out the specified change on every entry, retain unassigned rows, and select the complete result.

fixed_features.feature: 3-by-3 matrices and five math radio choices
fixed_features.justification: Every captured bank uses this shape and response format; conservative fidelity preserves workload.

fixed_features.feature: Specified row operation rather than choosing a suitable operation
fixed_features.justification: Lesson separates applying coefficient operations from subsequent augmented/identifying-operation KPs.
The easy scaling source q-130006 uses reciprocal multiplication giving integers. Applying integrality constraints to the entire bank avoids a fractional-format key cue.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any two distinct rows; reversing the textual pair preserves the transformation.
answer_roles.observed: All three unordered pairs observed; controlled pair and operand-order tests passed.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All three rows; signed nonzero integer/reciprocal factors of comparable arithmetic.
answer_roles.observed: All targets appear in controls; same-data factor and target pairs follow the requested operation in prompt, solution, key and grader.

answer_roles.role: Moderate addition donor/target and cancellation location
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any distinct rows and optional cancellation at any column.
answer_roles.observed: All target rows sampled; production optional cancellation is separate from source replay banks. q-10243 complete source bank unavailable.

answer_roles.role: Hard operation destinations and shared donor
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Two additions may share a destination (q-130010) or share a donor with distinct destinations (q-130064, q-130065, q-10245).
answer_roles.observed: FAIL: normal generation forces one repeated destination with the other rows as two donors; all 60 hard controls share this restriction. Distinct-destination cases are replay only.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five positions independently of mathematical roles.
answer_roles.observed: Positions vary per recognizable production profile and in exact batch; actual UI performs an additional deterministic order transformation.

coverage.result: 9/11 complete banks reproduced. q-10251 and q-10243 are rejected as unknown profiles; source replay fails.
60 fresh seeds per difficulty, 72011..72070. Easy includes 37 swaps and 23 scales; hard always changes one destination. Invalid same-row swaps, zero scaling and duplicate rows rejected.

coverage.case: Exact batch versus accepted larger control
coverage.result: All 5 batch records and all 60 easy controls survive. Exact batch is five swaps across all three pairs, with no demonstrated all-item surface shortcut; it does not cover scaling. Captured easy inventory plus batch would contain 11 swaps and 2 scales.

counterfactuals.change: Same matrix, seed, and swap-complete bank: rows [0,1] to [0,2].
counterfactuals.expected: Full result changes from swapping first/second to swapping first/third; old result is rejected and new result accepted within the same bank.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, explanatory row names, final matrix, key and all five native choice outcomes follow the new swap. Screenshots show both results.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson permits switching any two rows; the source pair is incidental.

counterfactuals.change: Same scaling matrix, target, candidate factors and seed: requested factor 1/3 to -1/2.
counterfactuals.expected: Scaled first row changes [2,-2,0] to [-3,3,0]; old key becomes wrong in same bank.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt and expanded products change, key moves to the correct value, and native grading accepts the new result while rejecting other bank entries. Both screenshots inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson requires multiplying every element by the specified nonzero factor.

counterfactuals.change: Same matrix, factor 1/3, candidate bank factors and seed; scale target first row to second row.
counterfactuals.expected: Only requested row is divided by 3; other rows are copied unchanged.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent explicit matrices and native grader verify [2,-2,0] in first-row case and [2,0,2] in second-row case. Prompt, explanatory ordinal and expanded row move with the target.
counterfactuals.justification: No source or lesson constraint fixes scaling to the third row.

counterfactuals.change: Reverse swap notation [0,1] to [1,0], holding matrix, seed and swap-complete profile fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Same resulting full matrix and same bank values; notation and explanatory row order may reverse.
counterfactuals.observed: Response value preserved, both correct choices accepted by native grader, and actual-UI screenshots agree. IDs/order may change because the prompt changes.
counterfactuals.justification: Switching two rows is symmetric; operand order is irrelevant to the operation.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: exact five-question batch in actual UI preview
shortcut_probes.strategy: Choose the first rendered radio option.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Baseline is uniform choice among five options (0.2). One of five correct; UI deterministically reorders the stored bank using item/field seed and choice IDs. These are fixture activity IDs, not predictions of future live order.

stages_examined: production parameter decisions before bounded rejection/resampling
publisher identity validation, normalization, inventory/batch deduplication
captured inventory and conditional uniform within-band learner selection with seen-before exclusion rule inspected
delivery.result: No sampled easy decision case removed by delivery. Exact batch remains swaps only. Existing captured easy inventory has six swaps/two scales; adding the five batch swaps gives eleven/two. Uniform selection is conditional on an eligible positively weighted easy band. Restriction in hard construction occurs before delivery, so filtering cannot restore its absent family.

limitations: Finite probes cannot establish the absence of every shortcut.
Actual policy weights and learner histories were not captured; exact live sequences and post-capture inventory are untested.
Unpublished batch has no assigned entity IDs, so exact future hashed draws cannot be replayed.
Captured inventory omits generation metadata. No existing generated record was demonstrated defective; empty affected-inventory is not certification of all stored records.
Native response format is radio selection; free-entry equivalent notation is inapplicable.
